data.one_liner: A widget and border to make cupertino rounded corners or squircles using bezier paths.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom SquircleBorder and a CupertinoCard widget that implement squircle rounded corners (bezier-based corners). Supports gradients, tap handling, and clipped paths for children.
use_when: You want to create iOS-style squircle rounded corners on cards or containers.
You need a custom border shaped like a squircle in Flutter.
avoid_when: You only need standard rectangular borders or circular border radii.
You are using a heavy UI kit that already bundles its own squircle implementation.
strengths: Provides both a custom ShapeBorder and a pre-built CupertinoCard widget.
Supports gradient backgrounds, ink splash, and click/press actions.
weaknesses: Limited feature scope focused strictly on squircle shapes and cards.
Changelog entries contain placeholder release dates.
